body.message:
For payment, send over your passport copy and email and we'll get a payment link across for the deposit. Rent is due before check-in, and once both are cleared you'll receive self-check-in details so you can head straight to the unit. Check-in is from 3pm, so as long as it's all sorted before you land, access will be waiting for you.

On the image, if you have a vehicle we'll need the emirate of issue, code, plate number, make and model, and colour for advance registration.

What date are you thinking for move-in?
